briefing: NASDAQ +2.6% and S&P 500 +1.8% made today a clear risk-on day, but cash is only $89.29 — far below what's needed to open a new position — so no new buys are possible despite 3 open slots. Holding all 7 existing positions, which are up +36.6% overall; strong performers should keep running rather than being trimmed on a bullish day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve to take advantage of good buying opportunities. Today was a strong risk-on day, but with only $89.29 in cash, the portfolio couldn't add new positions even though 3 slots were open — a reminder that having too little cash on hand can mean missing out on favorable market moves.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留現金以把握良好的買入機會。今日大市造好，但由於現金只剩89.29美元，即使有3個持倉空位，也無法新增投資部位——提醒投資者現金不足時，可能會錯失有利的入市時機。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices rallied today, with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.8%, indicating a risk-on tone across equities. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this move reflects general market data rather than a single catalyst. The portfolio's existing holdings benefited from this broad-based strength.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，納斯達克指數上升2.6%，標普500指數上升1.8%，反映市場風險偏好升溫。由於今日未提供具體新聞標題，這次升幅主要反映整體市場數據，而非單一事件所致。現有持倉亦受惠於這次普遍性的升勢。
